prompt: What was the last prose book written by the poet who referred to Wyndham Lewis as "that lonely old volcano of the Right."?
answer:
The poet was **W. H. Auden**. His last original prose book was **_A Certain World: A Commonplace Book_ (1970)**.  
(*Forewords and Afterwords* appeared in 1973 as a later collection of his prose.)
